timing_verdict.label: BAD
timing_verdict.text:
VERDICT: BAD timing to buy USD with KRW now

RATE: ~1,555–1,600 KRW per USD

WHY: The won is at its weakest level in 17 years (since 2009), with the exchange rate breaking through 1,550 KRW/USD and threatening 1,600. The news describes this as a severe won weakness driven by foreign investor outflows and strong global dollar demand, with analysts warning that won weakness pressure will continue in the near term.

TIP: Since you must convert $2,000 monthly regardless, consider locking in forward contracts or dollar-cost averaging smaller amounts more frequently to reduce exposure to further won depreciation, rather than waiting for improvement.
